notes:
Lead source: inbound signup (free credits, product-led). Trial started 2026-02-22. Primary contact = Rajiv Menon (Head of Eng) + L2: Priya Shah (CTO).

Summary: Small support-SaaS company building an in-app support assistant and KB search. Heavy chat + retrieval calls. High token usage due to long customer context + conversation history. Early feedback: users report occasional slow responses (esp. EU customers), and timeouts in the web app when responses take >6s. Important for them: fast interactive chat for support reps (target p95 <= 400ms on short replies, <=1s for multi-sentence), budget-conscious (watch per-token costs).

Recent timeline / activities:
- 2026-02-22: self-serve signup, ingested ~50k docs into embeddings index (trial).
- 2026-02-25: first demo w/ Samira (AE) — discussed Hosted API, simple routes. Rajiv: "We need snappy replies or agents won't adopt."
- 2026-03-03: perf call (ff_20260303_0912) w/ Diego (SE). Ran repro tests; EU region p95 spikes at 1.8s on chat generation, NA is ~0.6s.
- 2026-03-05: filed INF-1289 — customer saw repeated 504s in frontend; traced to client timeout + backend queuing at peak.
- 2026-03-10: follow-up email w/ sample logs (thread-1700b1c2e9). Asked for recommended prompt/payload changes and region guidance.

Key technical constraints & preferences:
- Workload: mostly short chat turns + retrieval-augmented summaries; some batch reranking jobs overnight.
- Latency targets: p95 interactive <= 1s (ideal 400–700ms), cost sensitivity: high.
- Model preference: small-to-medium open models for cost; willing to try Redwood-verified variants if perf is better.
- Routing: prefer single-region (eu-west-1 for EU customers) but open to multi-region if recommended.
- SSO: use Okta; need basic SCIM + SAML later but not blocking trial.

What we recommended in call (notes captured):
- Try switching primary API region to us-east-1 for internal QA to validate baseline latency (they observed NA < EU).
- For EU customers: suggest deploying requests to nearest region (eu-west-1) but enable fallback routing to us-east-1 during bursts. Explain trade-offs (cross-region adds latency for state transfer).
- Timeout settings: set client webapp fetch timeout to 12s for streaming; use streaming endpoint to render tokens progressively and avoid frontend 504s. Increase server-side request timeout to 30s for long-run ops but keep short-turn responses under 3s.
- Prompt tuning: remove repeated system instructions from each turn; send only delta context, keep conversation window to last 6 turns and important metadata. Recommend token cap of ~1024 for chat generations for interactive flows.
- Batching/caching: enable prefix KV cache for repeated prompts (support templates). Use embeddings-based rerank only when needed; precompute embeddings for KB docs to reduce live load.
- Model selection: test a quantized 7B Redwood-verified variant (faster & cheaper) vs standard 13B; run A/B on latency and quality.

Action items / next steps (choppy CRM style):
- AE (Samira) to send tailored perf note + checklist (today).
- SE (Diego) to run 2-region latency repro and share logs by 2026-03-14.
- Customer to try streaming endpoint + increase client timeout to 12s and report behavior.
- If improvements, propose small dedicated burst plan to cover high-traffic hours.

Customer quotes / voice of customer:
- Rajiv: "If agents wait >1s for a reply they'll open other tools — we need subsecond feel."
- Priya: "We like the price but need prescriptive tuning — we tried shorter prompts but lost context quality."

Open issues / blockers:

- They want example client timeout configs and streaming usage patterns.
- Procurement: finance wants ARR clarity before committed plan.
